_meta.description: Chord Dental Universal Location Configuration. This file is the single source of truth for all location-specific data. It is consumed by the enhanced chord_patient(action:'clinic_info') endpoint to return dynamic location data to the AI agent.
_meta.instructions: To add a new location: 1) Add an entry under 'locations' keyed by locationId. 2) Reference the appropriate insurance_group. 3) Add any location-specific insurance additions/exclusions. 4) Configure routing_rules, baby_wellness, and all other fields. The Node-RED clinic_info endpoint resolves insurance_group references to flat lists before returning to the agent.
